europe_now.title: Russian Strike Kills Dozens in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: A Russian strike on buses and a residential area in Ukraine resulted in numerous fatalities, including children. Emergency responses and reports highlight significant casualties amid ongoing conflict.

europe_now.title: French Student Protests and School Closures
europe_now.summary: Student demonstrations and funding demands in France led to the closure of multiple middle and high schools. Police used tear gas in Paris as protesters prepared for further nationwide marches.

top_stories.title: Spain Mourns Housing Protest Figure
